# Preregistration — Python ADP stress (ranex-stress-python-adp)

Frozen before any scored measurement. Worker: fm/ranex-stress-python-adp.
Date: 2026-09-26. Skills bound per phase: experimental-design +
statistical-power + uncertainty-and-units (this document); exploratory-data-analysis
+ statistical-analysis (matrix results); scientific-critical-thinking (self-review);
scientific-writing (addendum).

## Claim under test (C) — the scout's Python PROMOTE, as recommended for ship

- **C-L (lint)**: ruff@0.16.2 over a frozen subject scope, `--isolated`,
  explicit `--select` (E4,E7,E9,F baseline; E722 added per report §9 ship
  condition), `--ignore-noqa`, frozen `accepted` list; SARIF out.
- **C-T (types)**: pyrefly@1.2.0 over the subject, project config committed
  (`pyrefly.toml` strict-class), JSON out, severity mapped per report §8
  (`error` blocking, `warning` advisory).
- **Kernel plane**: `foundation/scan_results.py` reduction + digest-pinned
  `verdict.py` (untouched; sha256
  `2969aa74adc8ac40393fb4f782e05be8f29f34d2ab0f594051906f4e6a5b5ed6`,
  re-verified at setup).

## Pre-freeze characterization (Round-0, unscored, disclosed)

1. ruff@0.16.2 SARIF emits per-result `level: "error"`, no `artifacts[]`/
   `invocations[]` witnesses (measured on F401).
2. pyrefly@1.2.0 JSON: `errors[]` with `name/severity/line/column/stop_line/
   stop_column/path`. **Config dependence measured**: with no `pyrefly.toml`
   pyrefly runs preset `basic` — `x: int = "hello"` and `os.path.join(1, 2)`
   yield 0 errors, exit 0; with a toml present (any preset ≠ basic) both fire.
   Type-checking power is a function of an undiscovered-by-default config file.
3. Kernel scan reduction: result level defaults to `warning` when SARIF omits
   it; `missing` = scope path absent from subject or unwitnessed;
   `invocations[].executionSuccessful != true` refuses; accepted findings are
   keyed by fingerprint over subject bytes.
4. Pinned toolchain resolves argv[0] only from root-owned
   `/usr/bin,/bin,/usr/sbin,/sbin` (scanner residency G-3 stands).

## Fracture matrix (preregistered arms)

Every arm carries a positive control (known-bad input that MUST trip), a
negative control (known-good that MUST stay clean), and ≥3 repeats; wall-clock
recorded; outputs compared bytewise. Status vocabulary: VERIFIED / GAP /
FALSE-PASS / NON-DETERMINISTIC / UNVERIFIED.

### R — reproduction (scout headline numbers, independently)

| Arm | Design | Frozen expectation |
|---|---|---|
| R1 | KG blind bank, n=30 idiomatic files authored before any engine sees them | 0 findings/engine (FP 0/30; one-sided CP95 UB ≤ 10%) |
| R2 | KG extension: +30 files (pooled n=60) | pooled 0/60, UB ≤ 10% |
| R3 | KB plants: 12 classes (l1 F401, l2 F821, l3 F811, l4 E711, l5 E722, l6 E731; t1 bad-argument-type, t2 unknown-name-in-annotation, t3 bad-return, t4 missing-attribute, t5 missing-argument, t6 bad-assignment) planted one-at-a-time into six@1.17.0 and a ranex scratch copy | catch = every applicable arm (rule selected in subject's frozen ruleset); any miss blocks |
| R4 | determinism ×3 on every scored arm | byte-identical outputs |
| R5 | env -i on fixed subset (bank, six pyrefly, planted, governed cycle) | identical outputs/verdicts |
| R6 | governed MARGINAL in scratch governed repo (committed stdlib scanner) | clean→PASS; planted→FAIL; tree moved→FAIL; cross-gate→REFUSED; no-run→refusal; recovery→PASS |

### SP — sad paths / edge inputs (each into an otherwise-clean scope)

| Arm | Input | Frozen expectation |
|---|---|---|
| SP1 | syntax error | engine reports it; silent clean = FALSE-PASS |
| SP2 | unicode identifiers (valid) | 0 findings; spurious = FP |
| SP3 | 5 MiB generated file | completes, deterministic, wall-clock quoted |
| SP4 | 500-deep nesting | deterministic outcome (report or fail-closed); flaky = NON-DETERMINISTIC |
| SP5 | empty file | 0 findings |
| SP6 | UTF-8 BOM valid file | 0 findings; spurious = FP |
| SP7 | CRLF valid file | 0 findings; spurious = FP |
| SP8 | binary bytes in .py | reported/fail-closed; silent clean = FALSE-PASS |
| SP9 | concurrent edit: tree mutated between run and evaluate | digest FAIL |
| SP10 | scope path deleted post-freeze | refusal / missing-blocks |

### EF — environment fractures (must fail CLOSED; silent pass = FALSE-PASS)

| Arm | Fracture | Frozen expectation |
|---|---|---|
| EF1 | engine absent | refusal or recorded failure |
| EF2 | fake `ruff` earlier on PATH | toolchain refusal (non-root-owned) |
| EF3 | broken venv engine | recorded failure |
| EF4 | read-only tree (output unwritable) | recorded failure |
| EF5 | polluted PATH + fake config | refusal / drift surfaced, never silent clean |
| EF6 | env -i, no HOME | deterministic; same verdict |

### SC — scale

| Arm | Design | Frozen expectation |
|---|---|---|
| SC1 | 2,000-file generated monorepo + 1 plant, ruff | plant caught; ×3 stable; wall-clock quoted |
| SC2 | same, pyrefly | same |

### AD — adversarial (caught OR named HOLD finding)

| Arm | Attack | Frozen expectation |
|---|---|---|
| AD1a | new F401 + `# noqa: F401` under current-CI shape (no --ignore-noqa) | suppressed → documented FALSE-PASS of the unhardened shape (holds ship to the recommended flag set) |
| AD1b | same under recommended shape (--ignore-noqa) | caught |
| AD2 | bare `# noqa` + new defect, --ignore-noqa | caught |
| AD3 | `# pyrefly: ignore` + new type error | caught or HOLD (G-2 family) |
| AD4 | delete/relax subject `pyrefly.toml` (preset basic / absent) | type plants escape → config must be in frozen scope; else HOLD |
| AD5 | fake `ruff.toml`/`pyproject [tool.ruff]` in subject | ignored under --isolated; measured drift without → HOLD for discovery reliance |
| AD6 | engine version swap on fixed inputs (0.16.2 ↔ other) | outputs differ → version pin is load-bearing; enforcement = toolchain residency (G-3); unenforced in-band = HOLD |
| AD7 | SARIF forgery: (a) zero-finding SARIF on planted tree; (b) region past EOF; (c) snippet mismatch; (d) post-run artifact tamper | (a) documented zero-scope residual → HOLD; (b)(c) refused; (d) verdict unaffected (summary signed at run) |
| AD8 | catalog `accepted` self-service edit | catalog digest mismatch → refusal |

### SV — severity taxonomy boundary

| Arm | Design | Frozen expectation |
|---|---|---|
| SV1 | per-plant-class pyrefly severity + exit semantics | every applicable type plant severity=error; any warning-severity plant = misfiled boundary → HOLD; rate quoted CP95 |
| SV2 | ruff SARIF level across all fired rule families | level=error on all; any warning-level selected-rule finding = misfiled → HOLD |
| SV3 | reduction honors blocking_levels (direct kernel arms) | warning under [error] → advisory (non_passed empty); error → blocks |

### KR — kernel reduction (direct scan_results arms)

| Arm | Input | Frozen expectation |
|---|---|---|
| KR1 | region past EOF | refused |
| KR2 | snippet mismatch | refused |
| KR3 | accepted finding, bytes change under it | acceptance invalidated → blocks |
| KR4 | finding under rule outside frozen rules | still blocks |
| KR5 | malformed SARIF (bad JSON / wrong version / no runs) | refused |
| KR6 | scope path nonexistent | missing-blocks |
| KR7 | invocation executionSuccessful=false | refused |
| KR8 | result outside subject root | refused |

## Thresholds (TH) and decision rule

- TH-KG: FP 0 observed per engine, one-sided CP95 UB ≤ 10%.
- TH-KB: catch on every applicable arm; a miss blocks.
- TH-DET: byte-identical ×3, every scored arm.
- TH-ENV: identical outputs under env -i.
- TH-GOV: all six governed outcomes hold.
- TH-SP/EF/SC/AD/SV/KR: per-arm expectations above.
- **Blocking rule: any FALSE-PASS or NON-DETERMINISTIC anywhere in the matrix →
  final call NOT-READY.** GAP/UNVERIFIED/HOLD findings are named conditions; a
  HOLD on an arm in the recommended ship path also forces NOT-READY with that
  fracture named. Never retried away; deviations disclosed, never threshold-
  relaxing.

## Uncertainty discipline

- CP95 (Clopper-Pearson) intervals on finite-bank rates only (FP, catch,
  misclassification). Determinism and env-invariance are exact byte/digest
  comparisons and carry no sampling uncertainty. ×3 repeats are determinism
  checks, never rate replicates (no pseudoreplication).
- Wall-clock quoted per arm (single-run and ×3 spread) — measurement, not a
  threshold.

## Deviation policy

Amendments land in the addendum's deviations section with reason; none may
relax a TH. Post-hoc reclassifications must quote the raw record unchanged.
